narrative.overview: A studio at night with one car lit. The page is a premium configurator: the visitor picks Auto or Camioneta, adds extras to an already included wash, and the total and the WhatsApp message assemble live. The build is code-led (seed:ee9b98310585b7e6). A fixed scrollspy navbar and a closing map band frame the page. Studio black, panel grey, cold white, secondary grey and the red of a brake light as the only accent, divided by 1px hairlines instead of cards. Section titles are condensed bold uppercase Archivo (wdth 62%, weight 800); everything else is light Archivo with tabular figures. The only decorative motion is the split-flap price.
keyCharacteristics: Dark only; red is the single accent and is rare.
Hairline (1px) rules separate rows, plans, steps; no card grid for services.
Square corners everywhere except the 2px flap cells.
Condensed heavy headings against a light body.
Every color is a token in one `@theme static` block; no raw hex in components (the single exception is the `theme-color` meta tag, which cannot read CSS variables).
Fine film grain on page-level chrome surfaces only, one intensity.
Real photography of the owner's work; the hero is the only AI-retouched image.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Red is the only accent. It marks action (buttons), state (switch on, check) and sequence (step numbers). It never decorates headings or backgrounds.

rules.name: The Text-Red Rule
rules.body: Red used as text, icon or focus outline is Stop Red Text, never Stop Red. The one exception is the 2px active-link underline in the navbar, which is Stop Red (a line, not text).

rules.name: The Token-Only Rule
rules.body: Colors are declared once in `@theme static` in `src/styles/global.css`. Components reference tokens; overlays derive from tokens with `color-mix`.

rules.name: The Grain Rule
rules.body: Grain is applied with `.con-grano` at one intensity only, on the body, the navbar once scrolled, the vehicle bar and the mobile bar. Never on the hero, photos, panels, buttons or the map. Worst-case contrast on grain: muted 6.68:1, main 14.9:1, red text 5.7:1.

rules.name: The Width-Is-Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Titles are condensed (wdth 62%) heavy uppercase; nothing else is condensed except step numerals. Body never leaves wdth 100%.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every price and number uses tabular figures.

rules.name: The Flat-With-Hairlines Rule
rules.body: Separation is a 1px Line rule or a tonal step. No drop shadows, no glows. Surface texture comes from grain, not from shadow.

dos: Do keep Stop Red as the only accent and use Stop Red Text (#ff5258) whenever red is text, icon or outline.
Do set section titles in Archivo wdth 62%, weight 800, uppercase; body in weight 300.
Do separate content with 1px Line rules and tonal panel steps.
Do keep prices in tabular figures and animate changes with the staggered split-flap, under 800ms, respecting reduced motion with real text in `.sr-only`.
Do declare every color as a token in `@theme static` and derive scrims with `color-mix` from the bg token.
Do apply grain only through `.con-grano` on the listed chrome surfaces, at one intensity.
Do keep corners square (0) except flap cells (2px).
Do use real photography of the owner's work; mark any retouched raster with its provenance.
donts: Don't return to a grid of service cards with a generic WhatsApp button; the configurator is the structure.
Don't put panels or cards over the hero photo; type sits on scrims only.
Don't add drop shadows, glows or a second accent hue.
Don't use a condensed face for body text or sentence-case condensed titles.
Don't invent reviews, client counts, guarantees or superlatives (PRODUCT.md).
Don't treat the provisional logo or the dashed gallery placeholders as final identity.
Don't write raw hex or rgb colors in components or add a grain intensity; extend the tokens instead.
Don't put grain on the hero, photos, panels, buttons or the map.
Don't name the owner anywhere in public-facing copy or labels.
